summary: Desk theorems hold under independent checks: 60/60 checks at k = 16, curve facts at k = 16, 18, 20. All 16 verdicts were recomputed from the raw arrays with the frozen thresholds and the same outcomes; counts are identical except A/A, which depends on the bootstrap stream (27 or 28 of 30, held). 50,000 recorded frames were replayed frame-exactly with independent code. The reduced independent census agrees except one recorded cell, explained as a sampling excursion. Frozen files are byte-identical. Errata: one direction inversion in a README result sentence (E1, medium) and six low-severity wording, precision or provenance items. No measured claim or verdict changes.

checks.name: desk_lemma3_E_which_T_have_a_rational_half
checks.detail: k = 16 exhaustive over all 65671 affine points, with 2E(F_p) built by doubling every point (no logs): P in 2E <=> log even <=> x_P square (0 mismatches, |2E| = 32836 incl. O). T0 = (0,0) has exactly 2 rational halves, both with x = 1 at k = 16 (A+2 square), so y/x = h_T0 is a translated frame.

checks.name: desk_lemma3_Ep_which_T_have_a_rational_half_and_Kummer_map
checks.detail: k = 16 exhaustive: 2E'(F_p) by doubling = class (0,0) = {X - e_i all squares} (0 mismatches, |2E'| = 16418). Exactly one 2-torsion point lies in 2E': e0 = A+2 = 1060. Explicit F_{p^2} halving of 400 sampled T: every T has a half over F_{p^2}; pi(S) - S gives the bijection {'(0, 1)': ['1060'], '(0, 0)': ['None'], '(1, 1)': ['0'], '(1, 0)': ['1056']} (validator's own generator; (0,1) is canonical = class of the 2-torsion outside 2E'; the (1,0)/(1,1) labels depend on the generator choice and here agree with DESK).

checks.name: desk_halves_of_odd_T_on_E_defined_over_Fp4_not_Fp2
checks.detail: For 147 odd-log T at k = 16 the halving quartic (x^2-1)^2 - 4 x_T x (x^2+Ax+1) has no root in F_p or F_{p^2} (gcd with x^p - x and x^{p^2} - x), hence is irreducible, and f(x) = x^3+Ax^2+x is a square in F_p[x]/(H) = F_{p^4}, so the halves are defined over F_{p^4} and not over F_{p^2}. All 153 even T have a rational half. The brief correction holds.

checks.name: desk_every_degree2_function_is_iota_T_invariant
checks.detail: 18 degree-2 F_p functions covering every polar-divisor type (2O: Moebius of x; O+Q: h_Q incl. Q = T0; P1+P2 rational, conjugate pair and double point via (y - l(x))/q(x)), each composed with a random Moebius map: exhaustive over all points, every fibre has <= 2 points, every 2-point fibre has the same group sum T, T equals the polar-divisor sum (rational), and the 1-point fibres are exactly the rational halves of T. Since L(D) = <1, f_D>, this covers every degree-2 function up to Moebius (the general statement is the standard Riemann-Roch argument in DESK section 1, which is correct).

checks.name: desk_theorem1_translated_xframe
checks.detail: 6 random T = 2S at k = 16: a Moebius mu fitted on 3 points satisfies mu o h_T = M o x o tau_{-S} on every point; B_f(V) = S + B_x(M^{-1}V) as sets; B_f - S negation-closed; D_f = B_x +- B_x and the signed set of B_f = Sigma_x u (Sigma_x + T) u (Sigma_x - T) as sets of group elements; P_i + P_j = T + (Q_i + Q_j) by curve arithmetic. Also 900 E.iota_even control frames (t = 4, 5, 6) with the validator's own per-frame check (fit on curve points, verify on ALL points, census equal to the x-frame census on M^{-1}(V)): 900/900.

checks.name: desk_lemma2_B_eq_T_minus_B
checks.detail: 6 odd-T bases at k = 16: B = T - B and all signed pair sums = D u (D + T) u (D - T) exactly.

checks.name: desk_theorem4_no_within_fibre_relations
checks.detail: k = 16: for 40 odd T and every point a, 2a - T is never in E[r] (0 hits); 300 curve-arithmetic spot checks agree; even T give 16415-16416 hits per T. On E', classes (0,1), (1,0), (1,1) give 0 hits, class (0,0) gives hits. Self-paired fraction of x-frame points: 0.25 on E (2 of 8 cosets), 0.4999 on E' (4 of 8).

checks.name: desk_huff_coordinates_T_class
checks.detail: Own Huff model (e0 = 1060, ea = 0, eb = 1056): a x (y^2-1) = b y (x^2-1) holds on every point. Huff x: degree 2 (fibre histogram [0, 1, 32834]), constant fibre sum T = (0,0) = Wa; Huff y: T = (1056,0) = Wb. Both are 2-torsion, outside 2E', class (0,1).

checks.name: desk_jacobi_intersection_degree4_and_pullbacks
checks.detail: alpha s^2 + c^2 = 1 and beta s^2 + d^2 = 1 on every point. Fibre histograms show degree 4 (16416-16417 values with 4 points, <= 4 exceptional values). Invariance: c under {-1, tau_eb, iota_eb}, d under {-1, tau_ea, iota_ea}, s under {tau_(0,0), iota_ea, iota_eb} and not under -1. Own Velu isogenies: c = Moebius o x o phi_<(A-2,0)> and d = Moebius o x o phi_<(A+2,0)> on every point; s = g o phihat with phihat of kernel (0,0) (codomain order n, j equal to E's), g = Moebius o x o tau_{-S} with S rational of order 4, 2S = T_g = (2116, 0). The s identification, labelled derived in the README, now also has a pointwise check at k = 16.

errata.text: README answer item 4 (line 43) and REPORT.typ line 65 invert a measured direction: "An x-frame with the same T-shifted targets gets 1.00-1.17x of that count." The recorded ratio is the no-half arm's covered_full divided by the x-null's covered_shift in the same class: 1.0025-1.1740 over 60 cells (model 1.002-1.151; P5 60/60). So the no-half full set is 1.00-1.17x the x-frame set, and the x-frame gets 0.85-1.00x of the no-half count.
errata.suggested_fix: Reword to: "Their full signed set is 1.00-1.17x the set an x-frame covers when it decomposes the same T-shifted targets R, R - T and R + T (model 1.00-1.15; P5 60/60). Both need three decompositions of the same degree, so this is accounting, not a gain. [pcc:unverified]" Apply the same change in REPORT.typ and rebuild REPORT.pdf.

errata.text: Unit slip. DESK.md section 3 (line 123), copied in REPORT.typ line 617, says "E' x-frames have about N/4 more than E x-frames" right after giving the deficits in covered points (N/2 on E, N on E'). In covered points the model and data give about N/2: Ep.x minus E.x at t = 4 is 4.23 / 3.92 / 4.45 (k = 16 / 18 / 20) against N/2 = 4.0, and at t = 5 8.29 / 7.08 / 7.25 against 8.0. N/4 is the number of extra self-paired fibres, each covering 2 points. README line 211 ("adds about N/4 within-fibre relations") is right only if a relation means an unordered fibre pair.
errata.suggested_fix: DESK.md is pinned by FREEZE.sha256, so leave it byte-equal and record the correction in README "Errata" (or a sibling ERRATA.md). Reword README line 211 and REPORT.typ lines 385 and 617 to "about N/4 more self-paired fibres, i.e. about N/2 more covered points".

errata.text: README PC1 line (171) and REPORT.typ line 335: "detected at t = 4-6 in every k (CI upper bound <= 0.992)". At t = 4-6 the largest upper bound is 0.950 (summary.json 0.9495 at k = 16, t = 6; validator 0.9496). 0.992 is the k = 16 and k = 20 t = 8 value, and the t = 8 maximum is 0.993 (k = 18). The statement is true but cites the wrong cells.

A/A "held, 28/30" depends on the bootstrap stream. In the frozen run the k = 16, t = 6 E.x split interval is 0.9574-1.0008. With the validator's independent stream it is 0.9563-0.9994 at B = 2000 (27/30, exactly at the threshold) and contains 1 at B = 10000 (28/30). The verdict holds in every variant.
errata.suggested_fix: Add: "A third cell (k = 16, t = 6, E x-frame) has an upper bound of 1.0008; with another bootstrap stream it falls just below 1 (27/30, still at the threshold)."

errata.text: Provenance: README line 8 and REPORT.typ line 16 say "the run was committed at e783d12a5b". That commit touches only L1 files. The L3 run outputs (analysis/summary.json, VERDICTS.md, model_table.txt, data/SHA256SUMS, data/k20/meta.json and the final run.log) were added in 6d9cb1674a (03:43:40Z); data/k16 and k18 meta.json came in earlier sweep commits (3ccc863cc4, c36e9d186a).
